dcterms:description: The LAPPS Grid provides access to a wide range of tools and resources for natural language processing applications, facilitating the mining of scientific publications, including the identification and extraction of relevant entities, relations, and events.
dcterms:title: LAPPS Grid

dcterms:description: PubAnnotation is a repository of text annotations applied to biomedical publications, all aligned to the canonical text in either PubMed or PubMed Central, allowing for easy access and searchability through standard web protocols.
dcterms:title: PubAnnotation
